note: Public broker-research sources for fetch_research.py. Add an entry only for a note that is PUBLICLY and freely published (respect robots/ToS). Each fetched doc is digested ONCE by the Librarian and its claims are scored (state/broker_scorecard.json). Empty is fine — the Research pipeline also surfaces filings from the news log without any broker source configured.

source_schema.broker: AKD | Topline | JS | AHL | Arif Habib | ...
source_schema.name: human label, e.g. 'AKD Daily'
source_schema.url: a stable public URL or index page listing the latest free PDF

sector_map_note: The Librarian tags each note to tickers; room_score buckets a broker's claims per sector (banks/e_and_p/cement/fertilizer/tech/power/other) so a broker's bank desk and E&P desk are scored separately.
